claims.verdict: proved as written, using stated classical source leaves
claims.claim: Every ordinary positive uncoupled transformer-free network with at most two reactive branches and arbitrary resistor count has maximum error greater than 1/1000000 on five stated positive-real samples.

proof_obligations.nonnegative_degree_two_polynomials: Grounded spanning-tree and diagonal-cofactor rooted-forest sums; clear s^nL. Arbitrary resistor count changes coefficients, not the degree cap.
proof_obligations.open_short_floating_cases: Open and short constant reflections are separated directly; floating components are discarded.
proof_obligations.normalization_and_sample_domain: Coefficient sum one; positive-real s only; P+Q at most max(1,s^2).
proof_obligations.inverse_and_box: Both inverse products and target null equations replayed exactly; weighted inverse bound 439774/507 sends delta=1e-6 strictly inside radius 1e-3.
proof_obligations.cancellation: Strict positive resultant throughout the box forces reduced degree two.
proof_obligations.classical_coverage: Morelli 2019 Theorem 3.1, regularity conditions, Table 5.10 and Theorem A.9. Source theorem leaves remain external to the arithmetic kernel.
proof_obligations.exceptional_bridge: Correctly retained; nonregular physical control has (t,K,lambda1,lambda2,mu1)=(8,64,-32,-8,64). Erroneous caption is not used.
proof_obligations.boundaries: Normalized coefficient subsequences and closed weak-sign relaxations; strict separating box excludes all such limits.

claims.formal_scope: Not a complete Lean proof of this universal separator or the classical classification.

claims.verdict: proved as written; actual finite KCL-to-port implication kernel-checked

proof_obligations.physical_existence: Strictly positive real compound branch impedances give accretive grounded nodal systems; floating/open cases treated separately. Written proof; Lean theorem assumes solutions.
proof_obligations.factor_and_conjugation: Complex Green identity with conjugated currents gives power; bilinear nonconjugated identity gives finite change. Lean port_power and graph_to_port check the factor 4 and conjugation.
proof_obligations.simultaneous_changes: Finite weighted Cauchy-Schwarz uses one common maximum branch budget; no sum of independent per-branch budgets or branch-count factor.
proof_obligations.disk: Exact polynomial completion checked in Lean; A>=1 follows from passivity and B>=0.
proof_obligations.zero_loss: Changed ideal reactive edges violate local hypothesis; the previous counterexample is preserved.

non_claims: No complete universal analytic or hardware proof

claims.verdict: proved as written for the explicit model; finite implementation replay passed

proof_obligations.dedicated_loss: Each L/C pair has its own positive R and an unbranched internal series node; a remote shared R cannot qualify.
proof_obligations.continuous_box: a>=1-delta, abs(a-1)<=delta, abs(b-1)<=delta/(1-delta); local finite bound follows for every component value in the box.
proof_obligations.band: Nominal kappa is the maximum of omega_max L/R and 1/(omega_min C R); this bounds the entire positive band, not just displayed samples.
proof_obligations.reference: Fixed positive real reference; normalization preserves local ratios.
proof_obligations.sharpness_and_use: Capacitive local corner attains B. At kappa=10, delta=1/100 and nominal Gamma=0, reflected power <=1009801/389129401<1/385.

claims.implementation_independence: Compound and expanded physical graph assembly are separately compared; exact complex arithmetic and Gaussian solver are shared. This is not a wholly independent second numerical solver.
claims.remaining: Parasitic branches, nonlinear/frequency-dependent part models, justified ESR data, internal dissipation and measurements remain outside the specified guarantee.

claims.verdict: selected one-step finite algebraic obligation proved in Lean

proof_obligations.scope: Any finite retained-node type; real potentials; parallel conductances already summed; arbitrary existing conductances.
proof_obligations.nonzero_degree: KCL uniquely fixes the weighted-average potential; symmetric nonnegative star-mesh update preserves every retained current.
proof_obligations.zero_degree: Nonnegative conductances summing to zero are all zero.
proof_obligations.not_closed: Arbitrary iteration with full open/short boundary semantics and analytic compact-model limits still require their own formal chain.
